items.description: Surge-damaged speaker system and TV set (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Lightning overvoltage covered under 2.3.3; the description establishes there was no surge protection, so the indemnity is halved, and the result is subject to the EUR 5,000 aggregate appliance sub-limit and 7.1.9. Estimated market replacement of about EUR 3,000 for both items, halved to about EUR 1,500.

items.description: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out (3 pcs)
items.rationale: Diagnostics and assessment are a contractor's own diagnostic outlay under 7.1.8(e), not a repair cost. The call-out may be indemnifiable under 7.1.8(d) because it sits on the same invoice as covered work, but the line is assessed by its predominant purpose under 7.1.10, which is likely not indemnifiable.
